title: StreetDesignAI: A Multi-Persona Evaluation System for Inclusive Infrastructure Design

bias_targets.methodology: Pre- and post-study Likert-scale surveys and semi-structured interviews evaluating changes in designers' ability to understand diverse user needs and their confidence in designing for users whose comfort levels and experiences differ from their own.

Qualitative thematic analysis of think-aloud design sessions and interview transcripts to observe how designers (particularly experienced cyclists) engaged more deeply with and trusted AI persona feedback that aligned with their existing professional intuitions and personal beliefs.

Qualitative observation during user study tasks identifying designers' tendency to favor AI-generated numerical safety and comfort ratings as primary decision anchors, often at the expense of richer qualitative explanations.
